what_the_price_is: DefiLlama's price at the stamp nearest the midnight UTC that ends the day, within 2.4 hours of it. For a coingecko: key DefiLlama passes on CoinGecko's market price; no CoinGecko call is made
note: The coin of the Quantus chain, held as qtc.omft.near. CoinMetrics' catalogue refuses qtc. DefiLlama's series opens with one price stamped 02:01 UTC on 2026-09-11 ($48.15) and has none at the midnight that ends that day; the next reads $13.90. So the series is taken from 2026-09-12, where its unbroken daily run starts. Which markets stand behind CoinGecko's price was not checked. 1Click sets its own price for QTC (it lists the id custom:qtc), so this is not 1Click's number; on 1Click's twelve reads from 2026-11-01 the two were within 8%, hours apart. The dashboard's series holds over $1,000 of QTC from 2026-10-06
